text:
maria_cs: Quick check-in for Zenith onboarding — KMS policy sign-off is pending, security flagged cross-account allowances and audit sink certs. Are we still aiming for Wed cutover?

jake_se: Networking (VPC peering + BGP) is ✅. The audit-forwarder needs a TLS cert from their PKI to ship to SIEM. Also they asked for 5yr log retention which bumps storage.

olga_security: Their ask: remove broad AccountPrincipal and require an encryption-context constraint. Suggest policy snippet below to scope usage to the deployment id.
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowZenithService",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDCORP:role/RedwoodServiceRole"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:deployment": "zenith-prod"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

jake_se: I can apply a preview key policy to the preview key and run the deploy checks: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id abc-123 --policy file://zenith-preview-policy.json`

deploy-bot: preview deploy started for zenith-preview — steps: network, certs, kms-policy, audit-forwarder queued

tim_ops: Renewal note: Zenith said they may postpone if go-live slips >10 business days. Recommend we prepare three mitigation options: 1) temporary 90d retention, 2) one-off discount for month 1 of live, 3) allow customer-managed CMK as fallback.

maria_cs: Good. Jake —can you produce a quick monthly cost delta for 90d vs 5y and upload to the onboarding sheet? Also add warm vs cold storage split.

jake_se: Will do. Early numbers: 5yr retention ~ $22k/month additional; 90d ~ $1.1k/month. Sharing sheet in #ops-private.

olga_security: Legal wants our cross-account KMS addendum signed (we've added SOC/PCI language). If they block, fallback is customer creates CMK and we provide steps to rotate keys and reconfigure encryption context — more manual ops. I'll send the addendum template.

maria_cs: Owners: Jake (apply preview policy + cost calc), Olga (send addendum + attach template), Tim (prepare mitigation messaging for execs). zenith_security — what's your ETA on legal review?

zenith_security: zenith_security: We can review the policy Mon morning. Legal has tight calendar but will try to return signed addendum by Tue EOD. Cert issuance may take 24h once we provide CSR.

maria_cs: Thanks. I'll log renewal risk = elevated and note the fallback path. Small runbook request: please update priv-deploy/runbooks/zenith-onboard.md to include 'customer-CMK-fallback.md' steps and escalation contacts. I'll open a PR.

jake_se: PR created: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/runbooks/pulls/99 — includes policy diff, cert CSR command, and audit-forwarder retry logic.

legal-review-bot: addendum-v1 uploaded to zenith/legal-review bucket — notification sent to zenith_legal@zenith.example.com
deploy-bot: CI for PR #99: all checks passed. Preview env deployed to zenith-preview. Audit-forwarder reported successful TLS handshake to SIEM (last 15m).

tim_ops: Marked renewal-risk = elevated-high for Monday exec brief. I'll include timeline + mitigation and dollar impact.

maria_cs: OK team — maintain Tue/EOD milestone for preview policy in place. Reconvene Mon 9:30 PT if no signed addendum by then. Thanks everyone for quick turn.
